title: Yosoi Benchmark Lab current local snapshot
knownLimitations: Local working-copy source archive, not a published release artifact.
One workstation; power/frequency and unrelated background work not controlled.
Six browser c4 campaigns stopped at the declared 3 GiB aggregate RSS cap and have no ranked timing.
Yosoi default byte-to-value location may stream eligible plans; explicit parse/locate phases measure retained trees.
lol_html is ranked for caveman byte-to-value only; no retained-DOM or pre-parsed-locate timing is invented.
Sampled RSS can miss brief peaks and sums shared pages; no PSS or allocation counts were collected.
September results use different source/compiler/dependency/browser identities and are historical context.
